sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2024
sources.text: While underway, the ship engineer sighted four perpetrators armed with knives in the engine room. The master raised the alarm and mustered the crew. A search was conducted and some engine spares were missing. The master reported the incident through his local agent via email to Singapore Port Operations Control Centre (POCC). A safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force
